title: Crash reporting
description: Firebase Crashlytics for iOS and Android through React Native Firebase, with a no-op web implementation and error-boundary reporting.

markers.block:
['@react-native-firebase/app', { ios: { disableSPM: true } }],
    ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { useFrameworks: 'static', forceStaticLinking: ['RNFBApp', 'RNFBAnalytics', 'RNFBRemoteConfig', 'RNFBCrashlytics', 'RNFBPerf', 'RNFBAppCheck', 'RNFBFirestore', 'RNFBAuth', 'RNFBMessaging'] } }],

notes: Crashlytics is native-only: it needs a development or production build, not Expo Go.
google-services.json and GoogleService-Info.plist are written by `radiance setup firebase` (paths are in scaffold app.config).
Crashes are reported on the next app launch, not immediately.
iOS uses CocoaPods Firebase (disableSPM) with static frameworks — required on Xcode 26+; SPM + dynamic hits SwiftUICore linker errors.
